FOOTBALL ROUND-UP

You've seen how our First Team got on, but what about the rest of the club?
It was another busy round of football across Eccleshall FC, with plenty of action throughout our pathway. Here’s how our sides got on.

Reserves 0-2 Newcastle Town
A tough afternoon for the Reserves, who were unable to find a way past Newcastle Town and had to settle for defeat this time around. On to the next one, lads!

U18 Floodlit 5-2 Stapenhill
A fantastic result for our U18 Floodlit side, finding the net five times on their way to an impressive victory over Stapenhill.

U16 3-0 Telford Town
Another excellent result, with the U16s securing a 3-0 victory and, just as importantly, a clean sheet. A brilliant team performance and three goals to celebrate!

U13 - No Game
No fixture for our U13s this time around, so they'll be ready and waiting for their next opportunity to get back out on the pitch.

U12 MJPL 3-3 Coventry Alvis
Goals aplenty in this one! The U12 MJPL side shared six goals with Coventry Alvis in an entertaining 3-3 draw.

U12 0-2 Cheadle S.M.U Youth
A difficult result for them on Sunday against Cheadle S.M.U Youth. Plenty for the team to take from the game as they continue their development together.

A SPECIAL SHOUTOUT TO JUKE! 🧤
Our U16 goalkeeper put in a proper Eccleshall FC shift! After starting his day between the sticks and helping the U16s to a 3-0 win and a clean sheet, he then headed over to warm up with the First Team.

But his footballing duties still weren't finished! Juke rounded off the day at the local bonfire, helping out at the club's penalty shootout stall, where he faced more than 300 shots throughout the evening!

We reckon those gloves, and Juke, have earned a well-deserved rest!

A huge well done to Juke, and a massive thank you to every player, coach, manager, parent and volunteer who represents and supports the club each week.

From the youth teams through to senior football, every fixture is another part of the Eccleshall FC story.

Different teams, different results, one Eccleshall FC.

REMEMBRANCE SUNDAY | LEST WE FORGET

This morning, Dave Heelis laid a wreath at the Eccleshall War Memorial on behalf of everyone at Eccleshall FC, following a poignant Service of Remembrance at the church.

Our club wreath can be found on the War Memorial, facing you as you approach the gate.

If you're passing through Eccleshall, please take a moment to pay your respects and visit the beautiful display of 1,200 poppies at the crossroads.

Among them are 81 gold poppies, each representing one of the 81 people from Eccleshall whose names are inscribed on the War Memorial.

A touching tribute to those who made the ultimate sacrifice.

We will remember them.
